boxes.meaning: to say out loud, speak out

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when someone puts words to a thought, feeling, or opinion.
Use this when the utterance specifically puts words or content into speech, rather than merely making a vocal sound.
Use 講出 when naming means stating or disclosing information, such as demands or someone's name.

examples.english: I want to voice my feelings.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 gong2 ceot1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gam2 sau6

examples.english: I finally utter the words I had always been afraid to say.
